theme: Per-link loss rates from end-to-end probes only
title: Root-Anchored Loss Tomography
strategies: dump-on-first-edge baseline: within every ambiguous probed run, charge the whole known sum to the root-side edge and zero the rest; untouched edges get a flat guess -- feasible but structurally blind

equal-split greedy: distribute each ambiguous run's known sum evenly across its edges (the textbook minimum-norm / least-squares answer); untouched edges still get a flat guess -- ignores how leaf-heavy each specific edge in the run actually is

leaf-count-weighted canonical split: split each ambiguous run's known sum proportional to leaf counts read directly from the given topology, and calibrate the per-leaf constant from the runs that ARE fully identified before extrapolating it to edges no probe ever touches -- exploits the identifiable subspace instead of guessing an arbitrary representative
exchange search over which additional nodes to (hypothetically) probe / weighted local refinement of the canonical split
